name: What are common closing costs when purchasing an oceanfront condo in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What are common closing costs when purchasing an oceanfront condo in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common closing costs for an oceanfront condo in South Florida typically range from 2% to 5% of the purchase price, excluding prepaid property taxes and insurance. These can include title insurance, lender fees, appraisal fees, inspection fees, and attorney fees. Additionally, buyers often pay for a portion of the owner's title insurance and documentary stamp taxes on the mortgage. Understanding these upfront expenses is crucial for budgeting. Kelby Contreras can help provide a detailed breakdown of estimated closing costs specific to your chosen property and county within our service areas.
